name: OpenDesign
summary: Open-source, local-first workspace that turns a coding agent into a design engine with SKILL.md skills and DESIGN.md brand systems.
description: An open-source AI design workspace where Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or another coding agent becomes the design engine, steered by composable SKILL.md skills and portable DESIGN.md brand systems. It produces prototypes, live dashboards, slide decks, images and MP4 motion graphics as real files, with a macOS/Windows desktop app, a local daemon with web UI and an od CLI; 138 design skills, 151 design systems and 458+ plugins ship with it.
